title: Ratio of Each Category to Total Revenue
description: Calculate each product category's **total sales amount** and its **percentage of overall revenue** (revenue_pct). Use a scalar subquery for the grand total. Round revenue_pct to 2 decimal places and order by total sales descending.
solution_sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(amount) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sales), 2) AS revenue_pct FROM sales GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

test_cases.description: 4 categories. Grand total=2605. Electronics=2000(76.78%), Clothing=350(13.44%), Hardware=175(6.72%), Books=80(3.07%)

hints: Use GROUP BY category with SUM(amount) to compute per-category revenue totals.
Divide each category sum by a scalar subquery (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sales) which returns the grand total — multiply by 100 for a percentage.
explanation: The scalar subquery (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sales) returns 2605.00 — the single grand total — and is evaluated once. Each category sum is divided by this value. Electronics = 2000/2605×100 = 76.78%. Clothing = 350/2605×100 = 13.44%. Hardware = 175/2605×100 = 6.72%. Books = 80/2605×100 = 3.07%. The four percentages sum to approximately 100%.
